author: Stahly
description:
Kill Team: Exodite arrives this weekend, and with it finally come official Exodite models. The included Dossier contains plenty of lore as well as build guides for the Aeldari maiden worlds, making it the perfect opportunity to start a new terrain collection. For this, I grabbed a piece from the old Death World Forest terrain range, and also gave my Webway Gate a fresh coat of paint. Find all the photos and a painting guide in this post.

The post A maiden world comes to life: how to paint Aeldari Death World Forest terrain appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: A maiden world comes to life: how to paint Aeldari Death World Forest terrain
